flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: pages/Report (Report.tsx, ReportList.tsx tabs per function ID, component/ReportSlot + DateRangeInput for search, lists/* grids, hook/useDownloadReport), utils/validation/Report.ts (date range limits), utils/data/LinkData.tsx and App.tsx (menu and route report/*), pages/Dashboard (empty). ocmsadminapi: workflows/reports/daily/DailyReportController+ServiceImpl (file list per date from blob), workflows/reports/system|agency (data report search), FileDownloadController (download/blob), OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor + api-authorization.properties (OCMS_REPORT_*).
note: The story asks for a common report module inside the dashboard to search for reports not routed to the officer, then view/download them. The Report module exists as the Report menu (route report/*) with 13 report tabs shown according to the user's function IDs and guarded on the server by the OCMS_REPORT_* mapping; search is done per tab with a date range (and source for 3 tabs). But the module stands alone, it is not part of the dashboard page (Dashboard is empty), search does not use a report name or keyword, the range is limited to 7 days (file reports), 31 days (Reminder), 6 months, or 1 year (PS), and many OCMS reports are not in the module (Monthly Paid/Exception, Daily Paid, and the commented-out tabs). On-screen view is the same as OCMS38.8: a grid for data reports, a list of file names for file reports. The Reminder, DataHive FIN and UEN tabs have permission mapping gaps (api-authorization.properties:144-145). Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-149 (Closed) and OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) concern report export.
recommendation: Can be claimed in part: the Report module with date search and download exists and works for most tabs. Dashboard integration, search by report name and coverage of all OCMS reports do not exist.

steps.step: The officer opens the common report module from inside the dashboard
steps.detail: The report module exists as the Report menu (menu.push(LinkReport), LinkData.tsx:390) with route report/* (App.tsx:317) and the Report.tsx:20-31 page containing ReportList. The menu is in the same staff portal sidebar as the dashboard but is not part of the Dashboard page, which is empty (Dashboard.tsx:17-31). So the common module exists, its integration inside the dashboard does not.

steps.step: The module holds the OCMS reports not routed to the officer, limited by access rights
steps.detail: ReportList.tsx shows 13 tabs only if the user holds the function ID (hasFunction, :50-146): Notice FE, RIP, Notice CRE, LTA, vHub, MHA, eNotification, DataHive Contact Info, Reminder Letter, CPS, PS, DataHive FIN, DataHive UEN. The server answers 403 for paths outside the function mapping (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:51-72; api-authorization.properties:115-153). The HST, TS, DOS, SMS, Email, Letter, AN and Workorder tabs are commented out (ReportList.tsx:147-201), and the Daily/Monthly Paid, Payment Exception and Monthly HST reports are generated by cron and emailed (cron-schedules-prod.properties:262-284) with no tab or source in the module, so they cannot be searched there. So only part of the OCMS reports is covered. The function IDs held per user: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The officer searches for a report (date range, source) in the module
steps.detail: Each tab has a DateRangeInput and a Search button (ReportSlot.tsx:147-149). Search validates the form then sends the date filter (and source for Notice FE/CRE/Reminder) to the grid (ReportSlot.tsx:54-80). File reports call POST /v1/daily-report/search, which reads the file list per date from Azure Blob (DailyReportController.java:18-37), maximum 7 days (DailyReportServiceImpl.java:23, 96-100; in the UI Report.ts:14-33). This search works for the reports the module covers. There is no free search by report name; the range limits and coverage are discussed in the previous step.

steps.step: The officer views the searched report on screen
steps.detail: Same as OCMS38.8 step 3: data reports show as grid rows (ReportListNoticeCRE.tsx:84-100; ReportListRIP.tsx:72-87), while file reports (LTA, MHA, eNotification, vHub, DataHive) only show fileName and fileSize with a Download button (ReportListLTA.tsx:56-95); the report content is not shown on screen.

Same as OCMS38.8 step 6: POST /v1/download/blob then saveAs (FileDownloadController.java:114-121; useDownloadReport.ts:22-40). The OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER mapping does not contain /v1/download/blob (api-authorization.properties:144-145) and OCMS_REPORT_DH_FIN and OCMS_REPORT_DH_UEN have no mapping, so downloads on those tabs can return 403 for users holding only those functions. The real function IDs per user: cannot verify from repo.
